chunks: And indeed, Jonah is one of the apostles.
ai.seo_question: Who is Yunus among the messengers according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm Yunus's status as a distinct messenger (rasul) rather than merely a prophet (nabi), highlighting his unique mission to the people of Nineveh. It serves as a bridge in the Surah's narrative, connecting the stories of earlier prophets to the ultimate vindication of divine messengers, reinforcing the theme of patience in adversity.
